# CoPILAR

> CoPILAR is Ben Heslop's model of how a member of a small, lasting group reads the group (Pillars, felt readings rated 1 to 10) and how those readings move one another (force cards), moderating her Engagement. The site holds two models: CoPILAR, the model in development, which is provisional, and ComPILAR V1, the published model from which it grew.

## ComPILAR V1, published model
- [v1/model.md](v1/model.md): every Pillar and force card in plain text
- [v1/model.json](v1/model.json): the same as data (pillars, axes, forces)
- [v1/](v1/): the Explorer; its Full text section (v1/#reference) holds the same text in HTML

## CoPILAR, in development (provisional)
- [draft/model.md](draft/model.md): every Pillar and force card in plain text
- [draft/model.json](draft/model.json): the same as data (pillars, decks, shared Pillars with two faces, forces)
- [draft/](draft/): the Explorer, with Full text (draft/#reference) and From V1 to here (draft/#path)

## Other pages
- [how-it-works/](how-it-works/)
- [blog/](blog/)

Claim ceiling: Synthetic reviews and simulated games show plausibility only. They generate hypotheses for human testing; they do not test the model. Draft Pillar texts are provisional until Ben approves them.
